## What's Changed

# OpenKruise v1.9.2 Release Notes

Bug-fix and security release for the v1.9 line, cherry-picked onto `release-1.9` on top of v1.9.1.

## Security

- **Disable pprof by default in kruise-manager and kruise-daemon** — [#2613](https://github.com/openkruise/kruise/pull/2613) by [@furykerry](https://github.com/furykerry)
  The pprof endpoints were enabled by default and bound to all interfaces (`:8090` manager, `:10222` daemon) with no auth or TLS. Any pod on the cluster network could reach them and drive the manager into resource exhaustion; since the same process serves OpenKruise's fail-closed admission webhooks, that could block pod creation cluster-wide. `--enable-pprof` now defaults to `false`.

## Bug Fixes

### Stability / panic prevention

- **WorkloadSpread: prevent panic on nil `spec.parallelism` and replicas** — [#2568](https://github.com/openkruise/kruise/pull/2568) by [@neo0007777](https://github.com/neo0007777) (fixes #2523, #2569)
  A `batch/v1.Job` without `spec.parallelism` set crashed the controller manager with a nil pointer dereference; Deployment/StatefulSet/ReplicaSet/CloneSet with unset replicas could trigger the same. Now safely defaults to `1` via `ptr.Deref(..., 1)`, including in the shared `controllerfinder` package.
- **PodUnavailableBudget: prevent panic on nil `Spec.Replicas` during update event** — [#2529](https://github.com/openkruise/kruise/pull/2529) by [@vishalmore90](https://github.com/vishalmore90)
- **NodePodProbe: fix nil labels panic** — [#2500](https://github.com/openkruise/kruise/pull/2500) by [@Jayant-kernel](https://github.com/Jayant-kernel)

### Controller correctness

- **Fix occasional restarts of kruise-controller-manager** — [#2382](https://github.com/openkruise/kruise/pull/2382) by [@PersistentJZH](https://github.com/PersistentJZH)
  Registers built-in API field indexes first and fails fast for them, while retrying CRD field-index registration when discovery has not yet observed the resource.
- **AdvancedCronJob: watch `batchv1.Job` with owner `AdvancedCronJob` instead of `BroadcastJob`** — [#2594](https://github.com/openkruise/kruise/pull/2594) by [@bhuvan-somisetty](https://github.com/bhuvan-somisetty) (fixes #2593)
  The wrong owner type caused controller-runtime to reject all child-Job events, leaving `status.active` stale and postponing history-limit cleanup.
- **DaemonSet: handle legacy owner reference versions** — [#2518](https://github.com/openkruise/kruise/pull/2518) by [@Colvin-Y](https://github.com/Colvin-Y) (fixes #2517)
  Resolves Pod owner references by Group and Kind so v1alpha1-created Pods continue to enqueue the v1beta1 controller after upgrade; skips parsing for unrelated controllers' owner refs.
- **CloneSet: fix Pods remaining NotReady when `UpdateStrategy` is `OnDelete`** — [#2291](https://github.com/openkruise/kruise/pull/2291) by [@zmberg](https://github.com/zmberg)
- **ImagePullJob: join image name and digest with `@` instead of `:`** — [#2556](https://github.com/openkruise/kruise/pull/2556) by [@qnduncan](https://github.com/qnduncan)
  Recombination sites used `:`, producing invalid references like `name:sha256:...`; any ImagePullJob whose `spec.image` carried a digest failed on every node until `backoffLimit` was exhausted. Adds `daemonutil.JoinImageNameTag` and fixes the CRI pull paths, `ContainsImage`, secret auth-info parsing, and related logs/events/status.


### Validation / webhook & input handling

- **Calculator: reject malformed numbers instead of reading them as `0`** — [#2595](https://github.com/openkruise/kruise/pull/2595) by [@anishmehta24](https://github.com/anishmehta24)
- **UnitedDeployment: format dereferenced replicas count in validation error** — [#2597](https://github.com/openkruise/kruise/pull/2597) by [@bhuvan-somisetty](https://github.com/bhuvan-somisetty)
  `expectedReplicas` (an `*int32`) was printed with `%d` without dereferencing, showing a memory address in admission errors.
- **PodProbeMarker: correct field paths in validation webhook** — [#2602](https://github.com/openkruise/kruise/pull/2602) by [@bhuvan-somisetty](https://github.com/bhuvan-somisetty)
  Paths are now properly indexed slice paths (e.g. `spec.probes[i].probe`, `spec.probes[i].markerPolicy[j]`) instead of flat root paths.

## Chores / CI (release-1.9 branch)

- **Bump `golangci-lint-action` to v9.3.0** — fixes cache-restore failure from v8.0.0's dependency-cache logic.
- **Bump `trivy-action` to v0.36.0** — the floating master-branch pin defaulted to trivy v0.65.0, which was deleted upstream (HTTP 404), failing the lint job on every PR.

## Test plan
- [x] `go build ./...`
- [x] `go vet` on all changed packages
- [x] Unit tests for changed packages pass
- [x] Note: `TestMatchRegistryAuths/test_credential_plugin_if_matched` fails identically on base `release-1.9` (environmental — requires a credential-plugin binary); unrelated to this PR.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openkruise/kruise/compare/v1.9.1...v1.9.2
